claim: Patchline ships Manski attrition bounds proving conclusions survive worst-case dropout. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the attrition bounds claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make manski-attrition-bounds-gate`.
